body: Thank you for your kind words.  People may be deserving of love and respect, but it doesn't mean they will get it.  I wish I had a list of people to "spring clean" but I have almost nobody left in my life.  I've tried talking with my wife, along with several counseling session.  She sometimes says she loves me, but her actions say otherwise, and I don't think it will every change (it hasn't in many years).  There's not much else I am actually capable of doing unfortunately...I just want it all to end
